errors.description: Section 4 misstates the mark positions: with interval lengths δ,2δ,...,2^nδ the cut points are the partial sums (2^j-1)δ, not 2^jδ. Harmless slip since only the interval lengths (9) are used in the argument.
errors.quote:
Thus his marks are \(2^j\delta\) for \(1\le j\le n\), all distinct and
strictly inside the stick.

errors.description: The 56-unit 'grid example' is described as agreeing with the theorem, but Liu's marks (7,21) give Γ=7, so Xiang could have held Liu to 31.5/56 < 4/7; the coincidence with c_2 is accidental. Explicitly flagged as non-proof evidence, so no impact.
errors.quote:
Sorting gives Liu
\((18+13+1)/56=32/56=4/7\), in agreement with the theorem.

parsed.notes: Drafting lemma, graph/tree lower bound (Γ ≤ D with ≤ q−1 cuts), overlay upper bound with correct cut accounting, subset-sum pigeonhole, and the q ≤ n bisection case all check out; answer verified independently for n=1,2. Section 5 is extraneous commentary but harmless.
